The story of Anima

2021Founded

25%of UK population

1,000+providers

Dr Shun Pang founded Anima after working as a medic in the NHS and seeing patients wait too long for the care they needed.

We began with individual workflows, then connected them into one platform. Our mission is supporting personalised healthcare at scale, with more time for healthcare teams to do the work they love.

What we care about

Our impact on lives

Our mission is delivering for the people who need healthcare, and the millions of staff who provide it every day.

Listening to frontline experience

We are built from lived experience in the NHS. We listen to the pressures of everyday care to improve our products.

Building through technical complexity

Interoperability has always been a challenge in healthcare. We focus on solving it, so systems and care teams can work together.

Taking responsibility

We know the privilege of the role we play. We raise concerns, act on feedback, and follow problems through to a solution.
